cases.question: ¿Qué productos vendieron más unidades en pedidos cerrados durante mayo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = so.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND p.sellable = TRUE AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 5
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_unidades FROM public.order_item AS oi JOIN public.sales_order AS so ON oi.order_id = so.id JOIN public.product AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-05-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND so.ordered_at < CAST('2026-06-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_unidades DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en mayo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pi.id AS id, pi.series AS series, pi.number AS number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS pending_balance FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi LEFT JOIN public.purchase_payment AS pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= '2026-05-01' AND pi.issued_at < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 LIMIT 50
